## What it says now, and what it should say

## The primary source
**A link to the platform's own documentation.** Not a blog, not an agency cheat-sheet, not a screenshot
of one. This repo's own rule (eval U22) is that a spec from a secondary source does not go in a gate.

If the platform publishes the figure only as an image with no text equivalent, say so — it gets recorded
as a gap rather than transcribed.
